layman_headline: Fear grips the crypto market — no clear swing trade setup warrants risking capital right now.
layman_explanation: The overall crypto market is sitting in 'Fear' territory at 27 out of 100, and it's been stuck there all week with a worsening trend. Bitcoin is down slightly over the past week, and most altcoins are bleeding harder — many are down 90-98% from their all-time highs. While a few coins like BONK and TRUMP show oversold RSI readings that sometimes precede bounces, their charts are firmly bearish with no signs of a bottom forming yet. The one coin showing strength (KAITO) is dangerously overbought with an RSI of 87, making it a poor entry point.
layman_action: Stay in cash and wait. The market hasn't shown signs of stabilizing yet, and chasing oversold bounces in a fearful market with high Bitcoin dominance is how swing traders get caught in falling knives. Watch for the Fear & Greed Index to start climbing back above 35 and for oversold coins to form actual reversal patterns before committing capital.
expert_reasoning: Per validated Rule #3, when Fear & Greed is at or near 25, the short-term outlook is genuinely ambiguous and HOLD is the safest call. At 27 with a worsening trend, we're approaching that danger zone. The two oversold RSI candidates (BONK at 29.35, TRUMP at 26.94) would normally be interesting given RSI's 71% historical win rate, but both show bearish engulfing candles, prices below all major MAs, and strong negative momentum (-26.5% and -8.8% 5-day). The risk/reward ratios are poor at 0.67x for both. BTC dominance at 56.3% is crushing alts, and with ETF outflows of $265M and no positive catalyst in the news cycle, this is not the environment to force a trade. KAITO's RSI of 87 is a screaming sell signal despite bullish chart patterns — chasing a +87% 5-day move is not swing trading, it's gambling.
risk_factors: Fear & Greed could deteriorate further below 25, triggering cascading liquidations and deeper alt selloffs
Bitcoin cold-wallet attack ($89M losses) could shake market confidence and trigger additional selling pressure
High BTC dominance (56.3%) means capital continues flowing out of alts — oversold alts can stay oversold much longer
watch_list: Fear & Greed Index — watch for any move above 35 which would signal sentiment stabilization and make oversold bounces more reliable
BONK and TRUMP RSI levels — if RSI drops below 25 while price holds support, that would be a stronger reversal setup
ADA momentum — up 12.8% in 7 days with 9.6% daily gain, bucking the trend; watch if this strength spreads to other alts as a rotation signal
market_context: Crypto market is in a fear state (27/100) with worsening sentiment, high BTC dominance squeezing alts, and negative news flow including $265M ETF outflows and a major cold-wallet exploit. Most alts are down 90%+ from ATHs with no bottom formation visible yet.
context_banner: Market fear is intensifying with no reversal catalyst — patience and capital preservation are the highest-conviction plays right now.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed at 27 with worsening weekly trend (avg 27.9) — per validated Rule #3, near-25 readings make the outlook too ambiguous to take directional bets.
BONK (29.35) and TRUMP (26.94) are oversold — historically a 71% reliable bounce signal — but both have strongly bearish chart structures that contradict the RSI signal.
Bitcoin ETFs bled $265M in 24 hours, signaling institutional risk-off positioning that typically pressures the broader market.
Bitcoin cold-wallet attack spread to 4,500 addresses with losses near $89M — a security scare that adds to negative sentiment.
No volume breakout signals detected on any candidate; ADA's 12.8% weekly gain with $492M volume is the only notable positive outlier but wasn't on the swing candidate list.
